source_title: Save $1,400 Off the Ultra Premium 2026 LG G6 Gallery Series 4K OLED TV and Score Some Great Freebies
source_excerpt:
One of the more noteworthy deals to come out of Best Buy's DoorBOOster sale.
LG's highest-end OLED TV of 2026 is on sale for just three days. As part of its DoorBooster sale that runs through this weekend only, Best Buy is taking $1,400 off the 65" LG G6 Gallery Series 4K OLED TV , now down to $1,999.99 with free delivery. In addition to the discount, you also get a bonus $100 Best Buy gift card and a free LG Sound Suite M7 Dolby Atmos wireless spatial speaker ($400 value). Both items will be automatically added to your shopping cart.
Save $1,400 Off the 65" LG G6 Gallery Series OLED TV
Get a $100 Best Buy gift card and a free LG Sound Suite M7 Atmos speaker
65" LG Gallery Series G6 4K OLED Smart TV (2026)
The G6 is the current generation Gallery series model, which is LG's highest end OLED TV and quite possibly the best OLED TV, period. It has superior image quality compared to the C6 because the G6 is equipped with an MLA (micro lens array) OLED panel with Primary RGB Tandem technology. Tandem OLED stacks multiple OLED layers on top of each other instead of a single layer. Tandem OLED is better than other OLED panels because: 1) it's much brighter, and 2) it's less prone to burn-in. The new 2026 model also has a new type of film coating that handles reflections better than before (LG claims that the new screen reduces reflections to under 0.5%), which makes it an even better option for sunlit rooms.
We picked the LG Gallery series as one of our favorite TVs for gaming . That's because it's equipped with a native 120Hz panel that can be pushed up to 165Hz with variable refresh rate. It syncs with games running in 4K at 120fps on the PlayStation 5 Pro and virtually eliminates stuttering or screen tearing.
One note to keep in mind is that none of the LG G-series TVs include a stand. They are meant to be mounted on the wall like an art installation (hence the "Gallery" monikor). Instead, a flush mount wall bracket is included.
